profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Thales
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with a passion for creating effective and engaging experiences. My days at work are spent deep in embedded systems, working with languages like C++ and Python, and it's a great place to tackle complex challenges.

But what really drives me is the creative side of building things. Outside of my professional work, I'm always tinkering with personal projects. I love the feeling of bringing an idea to life, whether it's a hardware project that integrates software, like my live subway map display, or a web application that solves a real-world problem. It's the challenge of figuring out how all the pieces fit together that keeps me hooked.

I find that my professional work experience and my personal projects complement each other. The problem-solving skills I use at work translate directly to my personal projects, and the creativity I exercise in my personal projects keeps me energized for my work. It's a continuous cycle of learning and building.

projects.title: Realtime NYC Subway Map Visualization
projects.description: This project is a captivating real-time visualization of the NYC subway system, built using an ESP32 microcontroller and LED strips to dynamically display train locations on a physical map. Leveraging live data from the MTA through a custom server, the visualization illuminates station LEDs in line-specific colors as trains arrive, creating an engaging and informative representation of the city's complex transit network. This project showcases skills in hardware and software integration, real-time data processing, and physical computing, resulting in a visually striking and functional piece that bridges the digital and physical realms.

projects.title: Walt Disney World Live Information
projects.description:
Built using: React, NodeJS, Javascript, RESTful API, GitHub Pages
React Web App that displays current wait times, next show times, and restaurant walk up availability for each Walt Disney World Theme Park.
Displays the wait time/status of every ride at the main four Walt Disney World Theme parks by utilizing the https://themeparks.wiki/ RESTful API.

organizations.name: U.A. Whitaker College of Engineering Ambassadors
organizations.description: The ambassadors are a group of students who volunteer for the U.A. Whitaker College of Engineering (WCE). The primary responsibilities of an ambassador are to attend outreach events and to promote WCE.  The ambassadors are in charge of advertising the engineering program and informing prospective students of the perks of being an engineering student at FGCU. Ambassadors collaborate with the Outreach Specialist to create lessons and activities to take to local schools that demonstrate engineering concepts.
